summary: The game crashes when putting items with max stack sizes above 64 into bundles
description: The Bug: The game crashes when putting items with max stack sizes above 64 into bundles. A crash report regarding this has been attached and can be found below. Stack Trace: [ crash-2024-03-20_16.42.33-client.txt] Description: Container click java.lang.ArithmeticException: by zero at cvk a.c(SourceFile:134) at cvk a.a(SourceFile:145) at crg.a(SourceFile:90) at csz.a(SourceFile:461) at cod.a(SourceFile:535) at cod.b(SourceFile:408) at cod.a(SourceFile:294) at fmq.a(SourceFile:370) at fmb.b(SourceFile:521) at fmq.b(SourceFile:606) at fdf.a(SourceFile:103) at fld.a(SourceFile:453) at fdf.a(SourceFile:103) at fdf.c(SourceFile:186) at boc.execute(SourceFile:108) at fdf.b(SourceFile:186) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFWMouseButtonCallbackI.callback(GLFWMouseButtonCallbackI.java:43) at org.lwjgl.system.JNI.invokeV(Native Method) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.glfwWaitEventsTimeout(GLFW.java:3509) at com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.limitDisplayFPS(SourceFile:236) at fde.c(SourceFile:1364) at fde.f(SourceFile:895) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:265) Steps to Reproduce: - Obtain a bundle. - Give yourself a diamond sword with a max stack size of 65 by using the command provided below. give s minecraft:diamond_sword[minecraft:max_stack_size 65] 1 - Put the diamond sword into the bundle. Observed Behavior: The game crashes. Expected Behavior: The game would not crash.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft in Creative mode with default settings.
2. Obtain an empty bundle by right-clicking on the Bundle item if you have it, or by crafting one using three leather.
3. Use the following command to give yourself a diamond sword with a max stack size of 65: `/give @p minecraft:diamond_sword{minecraft:max_stack_size:65} 1`.
4. Open your inventory and select the bundle.
5. Place the diamond sword with a max stack size of 65 into the bundle.
6. Observe that the game crashes when you attempt to put the diamond sword into the bundle.
Observed Behavior:
The game crashes when attempting to place items with max stack sizes above 64 into bundles. This issue is specifically triggered by placing an item like a diamond sword, which has been modified using the command `give s minecraft:diamond_sword[minecraft:max_stack_size=65] 1`, into a bundle. The crash occurs during container interaction and results in an arithmetic exception due to division by zero, as indicated by the stack trace provided in the attached crash report [crash-2024-03-20_16.42.33-client.txt]. The observed behavior is that the game crashes immediately upon attempting to place the modified item into a bundle, whereas the expected behavior would be for the game to function normally without any crashes.

To reproduce this issue:
1. Obtain a bundle.
2. Use the command `give s minecraft:diamond_sword[minecraft:max_stack_size=65] 1` to give yourself a diamond sword with a max stack size of 65.
3. Attempt to place the diamond sword into the bundle, which will cause the game to crash.

The expected behavior is that the game should not crash when placing items with modified stack sizes into bundles.
Expected Behavior: When placing an item with a max stack size above 64, such as a diamond sword with a max stack size of 65, into a bundle, the game should function normally without crashing or generating any errors. The item should be successfully added to the bundle, and the player should be able to continue playing without interruption.
